prompt: Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Aileron; characterful display serif with quiet supporting text. Use Spectrum 2-2: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F25, accent #864E1D, secondary surface #E9EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
